name: build-to-learn
description: Learn a stack by building a tiny app end to end (build, run, ship), then turn every problem you hit into layered learning docs: a short README, a detailed DEV_DOCS.md and topic files. The repo becomes your reference and a template for future projects.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a stack by building a tiny app and documenting everything.
interface.longDescription: Scopes a tiny app that exercises the whole chain of a stack, sets up the toolchain the standard way, builds, runs and ships it, logs every problem as it happens, and distills it all into a short README, a detailed DEV_DOCS.md and topic files. The result is a learning reference and a template for future projects.
defaultPrompt: I want to learn Go with GTK 4 on Windows by building something small.
Turn this project into learning docs.
